candidates.name: Official copies of register or plan: OC1
verified_facts: HM Land Registry states that an official copy can be used for legal proof and carries a timestamp/date of issue.
The official title-plan copy will likely show only general boundaries rather than exact boundaries.
semantic_limits: Legal evidential status of an official copy does not convert a general boundary into a surveyed exact boundary or supply terrain elevation accuracy.

candidates.name: Search the register
verified_facts: The public register-search guidance says title information normally contains general boundaries and there is usually no record of exact boundaries.
Official copies are distinct from ordinary online copies when proof is required.
semantic_limits: Register search or document status is legal/administrative evidence and must not be treated as numeric terrain measurement or DTM uncertainty evidence.
